components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one pressable action of a context, e.g. « Voir 12 activités ».
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #cf3a1b; color: #fff; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; font: 750 16px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -10px #cf3a1b; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #cf3a1b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Period Segments
components.description: Bottom-bar period switch; the active segment takes the action colour.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 4px; padding: 6px; background: #fff; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgb(90 45 20 / .08), 0 18px 40px -12px rgb(90 45 20 / .35); } .ds-seg button { border: 0; background: none; border-radius: 999px; min-height: 46px; font: 700 15px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #75655b; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed=true] { background: #cf3a1b; color: #fff; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #cf3a1b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chips
components.description: Age, price and registration facts; unknown values in soft ink.
components.html: Dès 4 ansGratuitInscriptionPrix ?
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-chip { background: #f7ede4; color: #2b2320; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font: 650 13px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-free { background: #dff0dc; color: #2c6630; } .ds-stamp { background: #fff0d1; color: #855400; } .ds-unknown { color: #75655b; font-weight: 550; }

components.name: Day Group Row
components.description: One white group per day; each row is a button with an illustration tile.
components.css: .ds-group { background: #fff; border-radius: 22px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(90 45 20 / .06), 0 10px 28px -14px rgb(90 45 20 / .28); overflow: hidden; } .ds-row { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr; gap: 14px; padding: 14px 16px; border: 0; background: none; text-align: left; font: 400 16px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2b2320; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row:hover { background: #f7ede4; } .ds-row i { font-style: normal; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #5d47a0; } .ds-row strong { font-size: 16.5px; } .ds-row small { color: #75655b; font-size: 14px; } .ds-tile { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 18px; background: #ece4f7; }

narrative.overview: A warm consumer app a parent opens with one hand, children beside them. It answers "what can we do now?" before anything else: the next activity is a big illustrated card with how soon it starts; the rest is a calm list grouped by day; period and filters live in a bar at the bottom, under the thumb. Warmth comes from the apricot ground, rounded type and authored illustrations, never from childish devices. Calm comes from restraint: white cards, one bright colour, and that colour only where something can be pressed.
keyCharacteristics: Apricot ground, white cards with soft large radii and soft offset shadows.
One saturated action colour (tomato), reserved for things you can press.
Each activity type owns a tint and a two-tone illustration; colour codes the type, not decoration.
Rounded humanist sans (Figtree, self-hosted), tabular figures for every time.
Light by day, warm dark at night (follows the phone's setting).

rules.name: The Pressable Colour Rule
rules.body: Tomato appears only on elements that respond to a tap. Information ("Dans 40 min") uses ink, never tomato.

rules.name: The Type Owns Its Colour Rule
rules.body: Type tints appear only on the illustration tile, the illustration and the type label; they never become page sections or borders.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every time and duration uses tabular figures so columns of hours align.

dos: Do keep tomato for pressable elements only.
Do give every new activity type a tint pair and an illustration in the same 64×64 two-tone style.
Do write labels in plain, friendly French ("Qu'est-ce qu'on fait avec les enfants ?").
Do show "?" for unknown age or price rather than hiding the chip.
donts: Don't add source photos (rights) or emoji/glyph icons; draw icons as SVG.
Don't add a kicker or eyebrow label above headings.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing, pulsing dots, gradient text or glass effects.
Don't make it childish: no cartoon fonts, mascots or saturated rainbow fills.
